methodology.execution: Cold, separate transactions on Anvil with production Game proxy, EntryPoint 0.7, Kernel 3.1/WebAuthn, SimpleAccount, production sendOperation gas padding, Alto and mock paymaster. One user operation per bundle.
methodology.chargedGas: UserOperationEvent.actualGasUsed for sponsorship (includes AA overhead and unused-gas penalty); receipt.gasUsed for direct keeper calls. Both retained separately.
methodology.advancedBattle: Locally seeded troops/research/stock/points and level-100 warehouses via compiler-provided storage layout; unchanged Game bytecode; fixture troops/research verified through Game views. Heavy case is the highest-cost ratio in the existing 7-ratio test search, not a proven universal maximum.
methodology.prices: Current public RPC fee quotes. Gnosis budget uses 1.5 gwei xDAI, not the near-zero RPC minimum. ETH spot from CoinGecko; xDAI assumed $1.
methodology.arbitrumData: Read-only NodeInterface.gasEstimateL1Component on each exact local transaction payload, all at one public Arbitrum block. Local signatures and chain ID differ from production.
methodology.limitations: Projected network costs, not paid mainnet receipts. Mock paymaster/provider estimates and chain-specific execution can differ. Observed API calls are priced from the official per-method credit table; production responses/polling can change call counts. Both observed-call and published-average marginal service projections exclude included credits. Excludes hosting/indexer/RPC infrastructure, retries and player acquisition. No network migration implemented.
